paper_metadata.title: Influence of Boron Content on the Microstructure, Superplasticity and Mechanical Properties of Ti-4%Al-3%Mo-1%V Alloy

evidence.quote: The influence of 0.01–2 wt.% B on the microstructure, superplasticity, and mechanical properties at room temperature of the Ti-4%Al-3%Mo-1%V alloy was studied.
Alloys with 0.01–0.1% B, similar to the reference B-free alloy, exhibited superplasticity at 875 °C
